primary_metadata_definition: width and height of pixel in cm (Pixel_size)
boundary_units: mm; distance_transform_edt sampling receives axis-specific resized spacing
area_units: mm^2; absolute foreground-pixel count error times product of resized mm/pixel on both axes
limits: Geometry uses publisher-provided pixel size; it is not an independent physical calibration study.
Nearest-neighbor mask resizing discretizes boundaries; physical-unit accounting does not recover detail lost at 128x128.
Native pixel metadata is scalar, interpreted as equal native width/height as defined by the primary descriptor.
